about: Photos for the 8 fictional sample websites of SD Tech Systems (/muestras/<site>/). Save each image as PNG at tools/sample-sites/images-src/<site>/<slot>.png with the exact aspect ratio. tools/sample-sites/convert.mjs turns them into WebP for public/muestras/<site>/.
rules: Photorealistic commercial photography unless the prompt says otherwise. Colombian setting and people where people appear (diverse Latin American adults).
NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or brand names anywhere in the image (signs, packaging, labels and screens stay blank or abstract).
Respect the aspect ratio exactly (crop if needed). Minimum 1200 px on the long side.
Keep the palette listed for each site so the photo sits well with the page colors.
